'''Cataalda''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in a seldom-traveled [[Cataalda system/Legends|part]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
It was a site of a [[Cataalda outpost|Rebel outpost]], which was abandoned after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered it in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].
